Title: Revelations
Writer: Sasha Hails, Simon Mirren, David Wolstencroft
Actors: George Blagden, Alexander Vlahos, Tygh Runyan
Plot: Louis experiences hallucinations. The Chevalier is arrested. Montcourt continues the robberies in order to fund the conspirators plot against the King. Some of the nobles want Philippe to take Louis's place as king.
